Welcome to another episode of GitHub Checkout! This week, Andrea sits down with James Clancey to take a deep dive into the GitHub Copilot desktop app. Discover how this agent-first experience replaces messy terminal setups with a clean user interface designed for parallel workflows. Learn how to leverage git working trees so multiple agents can work simultaneously in isolation without code collisions.

#GitHub #GitHubCopilot #ProjectManagement
